notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.3
notes.content:
This update includes the following changes:
• New game option available for changing the dialogue text speed
• Fix for the desktop cursor sometimes not being hidden on Mac
• Fixes for character animation blending and some missing animations
• Improvements to character shadows
• Fixes for some dialogue text and text formatting
• Fix for which dialogues trigger the "Lie, Cheat, Steal" challenge
• Adjustments to world collision

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.2 [Sumire now on iOS!]
notes.content:
Sumire is now on iOS and coming soon to Android! This update includes some optimizations, bug fixes, and improvements we added for the iOS port.

The changes include:

 A new musical easter egg found in Bo’s card game tournament. Can you unlock all the songs?
 Dialogue fixes and improvements to Chinese translations.
 Fix for some tutorial image prompts not appearing.
 Fix for color mixing issue in garden minigames.
 Fix for onsen lady not saving state after you’ve gifted her an item.
 Memory optimizations and performance tuning.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.1
notes.content:
This is an update for the Windows version that brings over some fixes and improvements we made along the way for the Mac version.
- Opening cinematic no longer using video player and now loads faster!
- Fixed an issue where Sumire's footstep audio sometimes played unnecessarily, as well as an issue where the wrong sound played for footsteps in the rain.
- Fixed a couple dialogue typos.
- Fixed a case where the Scarecrow task didn't get added to the notebook.
- Improved animations when giving items to some creatures.

notes.title: Sumire Sunflower Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37982564/19fbfd2fcf80752e45b1ed210770e2a25068612d.png
It's been 4 months since the release of Sumire! Thanks for all the support!
The latest Sumire update includes new language localizations, a card game mode, and some bug fixes.

To celebrate the occasion, Sumire is currently on sale at a 34% discount- so if you've been holding out, it's the perfect opportunity to check the game out!

---
Update features
New Languages
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37982564/28166b6fe5299223fff7ec9c0462f5530f8a9eb3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37982564/647a929a61cf72def54d86e8902cb6c60ef413b1.png
New language support for French, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese!

Card Game Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37982564/478788774943ee79a0a8365a4c818fc09e8fde94.png
Bo is hosting a card game tournament, and the kids in town are all joining in!
Duel against Kenji, Chie, and others in the new Card Game mode- the power of the card game might fuel some interesting conversations!

This mode unlocks after completing the game once, and can be accessed from the main menu.

Steam Points Shop Items, Trading Cards, Badges
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37982564/83dda8f6e10ea8500166097558f4fe367ff19555.png
Check out the new Sumire avatars, avatar frames, stickers, emoticons, and profile backgrounds in the Steam Points Shop!
There are many familiar characters from the game, as well as animated avatar frames with the distinctive beauty of Sumire's scenery.

We've also added Steam trading cards and badges as well!

Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue where player could get stuck after jumping over the stream
- Minor bug fixes to dialogue text and UI

---
Did you get all the achievements? See the "bad grandma" ending? Have you ever seen Kenji with a broken arm? Let us know!

- Added support for loading game progress from the demo into the full game.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support for Sumire and for all the feedback you've sent! This patch addresses a few minor issues that players have encountered:
- Fixed rendering issues with coins and the onsen scene
- Fixed a camera issue that could happen after fast traveling to the house
- Fixed some typos and dialogue lines appearing incorrectly
- Fixed some animations not playing correctly

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed bug where Sumire sometimes gets stuck when fast traveling to the Bus Stop area.
- Fixed Kenji board game bugs.
- Fixed an issue that some sound effects don't play at the volume you set.
